messages:
deploybot: Deploy initiated: tagged release v1.6.5-hotfix-mar2026 -> prod-eu1
deploybot: Commit: a1b2c3d (author: @samir), change window: emergency, canary policy: 2 nodes (5%) in eu-west-1, rollout: canary -> 25% -> 100%
jen: copying release notes here: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/v1.6.5-hotfix-mar2026  thanks
samir: running quick smoke on canary now
qa-bot: smoke results: 3 failures / 12 checks - mismatch in token normalization (log snippet: `normalizeTokens() -> expected 64 got 1`)
samir: seeing a small surge of 502s from inference-gateway-eu-west-1 about +30s after canary went live
matt-ops: pause rollout. QA failures + gateway 502s = hold. Pin traffic back to v1.6.4 for prod-eu1 immediately
olivia: @matt-ops ack. Pinning and draining canary now
deploybot: Canary paused at 5% per request from @matt-ops. Traffic pinned to v1.6.4-tagged for prod-eu1
jen: do we want to try a hotfix patch or full rollback? which is faster?
samir: root cause looks like a unicode normalization tweak in tokenizer in a1b2c3d. Fastest path is rollback to v1.6.4-tagged, then rework tokenizer in a branch with tests
matt-ops: agree. Initiating rollback and setting a 45m hold on further prod-eu1 deploys
deploybot: Rollback started by matt-ops: target v1.6.4-tagged -> prod-eu1
deploybot: Rolling back traffic: draining canary pods, switching routing config -> pin=v1.6.4-tagged
deploybot: Rollback complete: prod-eu1 back on v1.6.4-tagged. Health checks passing on all nodes. :white_check_mark:
olivia: preliminary metrics look stable, no gateway 5xx spikes on eu-west-1 now
qa-bot: re-running smoke tests against v1.6.4-tagged: all green
jen: thanks team. I'll mark v1.6.5-hotfix-mar2026 as blocked in the release notes and add a short incident blurb
samir: opening PR to revert the tokenizer change + add a normalization unit test
matt-ops: re-enable prod-eu1 deploys in 45m if no regression. tagging incident INC-2026-0420
deploybot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0420. Temporary lockfile added to release pipeline for v1.6.5-hotfix-mar2026 :lock:
jen: good catch everyone :thumbsup:
deploybot: Thread archived by deploybot at 2091004365
